subject: RV: How can i call gird.arrange with a variable number of graphics objects

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RV: How can i call gird.arrange with a variable number of graphics objects
parts:
Hi all,

 

Thanks to Dennis Murphy, I noticed the need to update some packages on my laptop and to correct some errors on the code I sent yesterday. The error concerns the call to arrange in the last line of the function, which should be do.call(grid.arrange, mplots) with gridExtra 0.6.5 instead of do.call(arrange, mplots) with gridExtra 0.6. This time I included bellow my sessionInfo(). Sorry for any inconvenience and thanks again to Dennis.

 

Best,

fernando

 

######################################################

# example of a function which takes a data frame and a number of rows.

# It uses grid.arrange (gridExtra or ggExtra) to combine ggplot2 scatter plots

# including all the combinations (using the bundle package gregmisc)

# between the variables in the data frame

 

x <- rnorm(100)

y <- rnorm(100)

z <- rnorm(100)

k <- rnorm(100)

df <- data.frame(x=x, y=y, z=z, k = k)

 

 

myfunc <- function(df, nr)

{

    require(ggplot2)

    require(gridExtra)

    require(gregmisc)

    vnames <- names(df)

    comb <- combinations(n = length(vnames), r = 2, vnames)

    k <- dim(comb)[1]

    mplots <- vector("list", k + 3)

 

    for (i in 1:k)

    {

        mplots[[i]] <-  ggplot(df) +

            geom_point(aes_string(x = comb[i, 1], y = comb[i,2])) +

            scale_x_continuous(name='') +

            scale_y_continuous(name='')

        names(mplots)[i] <- paste("p", i, sep = "")

    }

    names(mplots)[ (k + 1) : (k + 3) ] <- c("nrow", "sub", "left")

    mplots[[k + 1]] <- nr

    mplots[[k + 2]] <- textGrob(expression('Time (ms)'),gp=gpar(font=1))

    mplots[[k + 3]] <- textGrob(expression('Amplitude (' * mu * 'V)'),gp=gpar(font=1), rot=90)

    dev.new(width=6, height=6)

    grid.newpage()

    do.call(grid.arrange, mplots)

}

 

myfunc(df, 2)

Hi,


I think you want to use do.call with a list of arguments,

do.call(grid.arrange, list(p1,p2,p3, ncol=1, sub="some text",
left="other text"))


HTH,

baptiste

Hi,

I renamed arrange() to grid.arrange() in version 0.6.5 when the plyr
package (required by ggplot2) had just seen the addition of a
different arrange() function. I believe this name clash is what
produced the error reported below.

baptiste

> require(ggplot2)
> require(gridExtra)
>
> x <- rnorm(100)
> y <- rnorm(100)
> z <- rnorm(100)
> k <- rnorm(100)
>
> df <- data.frame(x=x, y=y, z=z, k = k)
>
>
> myfunc <- function(df, nr)
> {
>        require(ggplot2)
>        require(gridExtra)
>        require(gregmisc)
>        vnames <- names(df)
>        comb <- combinations(n = length(vnames), r = 2, vnames)
>        k <- dim(comb)[1]
>        mplots <- vector("list", k + 3)
>        for (i in 1:k)
>        {
>                mplots[[i]] <-  ggplot(df) +
>                        geom_point(aes_string(x = comb[i, 1], y = comb[i,
> 2])) +
>
>                        scale_x_continuous(name='') +
>                        scale_y_continuous(name='')
>
>                names(mplots)[i] <- paste("p", i, sep = "")
>        }
>        names(mplots)[ (k + 1) : (k + 3) ] <- c("nrow", "sub", "left")
>        mplots[[k + 1]] <- nr
>        mplots[[k + 2]] <- textGrob(expression('Time (ms)'),
> gp=gpar(font=1))
>        mplots[[k + 3]] <- textGrob(expression('Amplitude (' * mu * 'V)'),
>
> gp=gpar(font=1), rot=90)
>
>        dev.new(width=6, height=6)
>        grid.newpage()
>
>        do.call(arrange, mplots)
> }
>
> myfunc(df, 2)
